ideas.pitch: An AI-powered digital twin of Atlanta traffic patterns that integrates real-time GDOT sensor feeds with local event data using an auto-embedding vector store to predict bottleneck incidents before they cascade.
ideas.title: Atlanta Traffic Digital Twin and Predictive Congestion RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of combining complex data visualization and digital twins with local spatial data, making it highly relevant for judges looking for real-world impact in Atlanta.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that monitors incoming public health data streams, detects anomalies in patient metrics, automatically generates data lineage graphs, and opens verified pull requests to fix upstream parsing issues.
ideas.title: Auto-ML Data Lineage Incident Response Agent for Healthcare Datasets
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the architecture of recent grand-prize-winning data engineering and agentic incident response projects by demonstrating automated repair with an evidence gate.

ideas.pitch: A 3-turn evaluation benchmark suite deployed locally at the hackathon to measure self-correction and reasoning convergence rates across various 8B parameter open-source models.
ideas.title: Metacognition Benchmark for Local Open-Source Small Language Models
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of the DeepMind x Kaggle 'Measuring Progress Toward AGI' hackathon winner by focusing on rigorous evaluation and metacognition benchmarking.

ideas.pitch: A natural language interface that converts complex public safety datasets into interactive, production-ready dashboards in seconds using automated query generation and charting APIs.
ideas.title: Text-to-Dashboard Public Safety Analytics Engine for Georgia
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven formula of the Tableau DataDev Hackathon winner by drastically reducing the friction between natural language text prompts and fully rendered data visualization dashboards.

ideas.pitch: An agentic greenlight simulator that ingests unstructured pitch decks and historical regional box office data to autonomously evaluate script viability, budget risks, and casting recommendations.
ideas.title: Autonomous Studio Executive for Local Atlanta Film Archives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built directly on the grand prize-winning concept of agentic cinema workflows, appealing to judges interested in creative industries combined with rigorous multi-agent reasoning.
